001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.builders;
002
003import static org.apache.commons.codec.digest.HmacUtils.hmacSha256;
004
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.Message;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.builders.crypto.AllZeroSecureRandom;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.builders.crypto.Hkdf;
008import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.builders.crypto.HmacSha256;
009import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
010import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.authentication.Jpake1aRequest;
011import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.authentication.Jpake1bRequest;
012import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.authentication.Jpake2Request;
013import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.authentication.Jpake3SessionKeyRequest;
014import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.authentication.Jpake4KeyConfirmationRequest;
015import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake1aResponse;
016import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake1bResponse;
017import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake2Response;
018import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake3SessionKeyResponse;
019import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.authentication.Jpake4KeyConfirmationResponse;
020import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.Hex;
021import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.L;
022
023import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
024import java.security.MessageDigest;
025import java.security.SecureRandom;
026import java.util.ArrayList;
027import java.util.Arrays;
028import java.util.List;
029
030import io.particle.crypto.EcJpake;
031
032public class JpakeAuthBuilder {
033    private static String TAG = "JpakeAuthBuilder";
034
035    private String pairingCode;
036    private List<Message> sentMessages;
037    private List<Message> receivedMessages;
038    byte[] clientRound1;
039    byte[] serverRound1;
040    byte[] clientRound2;
041    byte[] serverRound2;
042    byte[] derivedSecret;
043    byte[] serverNonce3;
044    byte[] clientNonce4;
045    byte[] serverHashDigest4;
046    byte[] serverNonce4;
047    private EcJpake cli;
048    private SecureRandom rand;
049
050    JpakeStep step;
051
052    public JpakeAuthBuilder(String pairingCode, JpakeStep step, byte[] clientRound1, byte[] serverRound1, byte[] clientRound2, byte[] serverRound2, byte[] derivedSecret, SecureRandom rand) {
053        this.pairingCode = pairingCode;
054        this.cli = new EcJpake(EcJpake.Role.CLIENT, pairingCodeToBytes(pairingCode), rand);
055        this.sentMessages = new ArrayList<>();
056        this.receivedMessages = new ArrayList<>();
057
058        this.step = step;
059        this.clientRound1 = clientRound1;
060        this.serverRound1 = serverRound1;
061        this.clientRound2 = clientRound2;
062        this.serverRound2 = serverRound2;
063        this.derivedSecret = derivedSecret;
064        this.rand = rand;
065    }
066
067    public JpakeAuthBuilder(String pairingCode) {
068        this(pairingCode, decideInitialStep(null), null, null, null, null, null, new SecureRandom());
069    }
070
071    public JpakeAuthBuilder(String pairingCode, byte[] derivedSecret) {
072        this(pairingCode, decideInitialStep(derivedSecret), null, null, null, null, derivedSecret, new SecureRandom());
073    }
074
075    public JpakeAuthBuilder(String pairingCode, byte[] derivedSecret, SecureRandom random) {
076        this(pairingCode, decideInitialStep(derivedSecret), null, null, null, null, derivedSecret, random);
077    }
078
079    static JpakeStep decideInitialStep(byte[] derivedSecret) {
080        if (derivedSecret == null || derivedSecret.length == 0) {
081            return JpakeStep.BOOTSTRAP_INITIAL;
082        } else {
083            return JpakeStep.CONFIRM_INITIAL;
084        }
085    }
086
087    public static byte[] pairingCodeToBytes(String pairingCode) {
088        //return pairingCode.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
089        byte[] ret = new byte[pairingCode.length()]; // should always be 6
090        for (int i=0; i<pairingCode.length(); i++) {
091            ret[i] = charCode(pairingCode.charAt(i));
092        }
093        return ret;
094    }
095
096    static byte charCode(char c) {
097        if (c == '0') return 48;
098        if (c == '1') return 49;
099        if (c == '2') return 50;
100        if (c == '3') return 51;
101        if (c == '4') return 52;
102        if (c == '5') return 53;
103        if (c == '6') return 54;
104        if (c == '7') return 55;
105        if (c == '8') return 56;
106        if (c == '9') return 57;
107        return -1;
108    }
109
110    private static JpakeAuthBuilder INSTANCE = null;
111    public static JpakeAuthBuilder initializeWithPairingCode(String pairingCode) {
112        if (INSTANCE == null || !INSTANCE.pairingCode.equals(pairingCode)) {
113            INSTANCE = new JpakeAuthBuilder(pairingCode, null);
114        }
115        return INSTANCE;
116    }
117
118    public static JpakeAuthBuilder initializeWithDerivedSecret(String pairingCode, byte[] derivedSecret) {
119        INSTANCE = new JpakeAuthBuilder(pairingCode, derivedSecret);
120        return INSTANCE;
121    }
122
123    public static JpakeAuthBuilder getInstance() {
124        if (INSTANCE == null) {
125            throw new IllegalArgumentException("JPAKE auth session does not exist");
126        }
127        return INSTANCE;
128    }
129
130    public static void clearInstance() {
131        INSTANCE = null;
132    }
133
134    public Message nextRequest() {
135        Message request;
136        if (step == JpakeStep.BOOTSTRAP_INITIAL) {
137            this.clientRound1 = this.cli.getRound1();
138            byte[] challenge = Arrays.copyOfRange(this.clientRound1, 0, 165);
139
140            L.t(TAG, "Req1a: " + Hex.encodeHexString(challenge));
141            request = new Jpake1aRequest(0, challenge);
142
143            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_1A_SENT;
144        } else if (step == JpakeStep.ROUND_1A_RECEIVED) {
145            byte[] challenge = Arrays.copyOfRange(this.clientRound1, 165, 330);
146
147            L.t(TAG, "Req1b: " + Hex.encodeHexString(challenge));
148            request = new Jpake1bRequest(0, challenge);
149
150            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_1B_SENT;
151        } else if (step == JpakeStep.ROUND_1B_RECEIVED) {
152            this.clientRound2 = this.cli.getRound2();
153            byte[] challenge = Arrays.copyOfRange(this.clientRound2, 0, 165);
154            L.t(TAG, "Req2: " + Hex.encodeHexString(challenge));
155            request = new Jpake2Request(0, challenge);
156
157            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_2_SENT;
158        } else if (step == JpakeStep.ROUND_2_RECEIVED) {
159            request = new Jpake3SessionKeyRequest(0);
160
161            this.derivedSecret = this.cli.deriveSecret();
162            L.t(TAG, "Req3 DerivedSecret=" + Hex.encodeHexString(derivedSecret));
163
164            step = JpakeStep.CONFIRM_3_SENT;
165        } else if (step == JpakeStep.CONFIRM_INITIAL) {
166            request = new Jpake3SessionKeyRequest(0);
167
168            step = JpakeStep.CONFIRM_3_SENT;
169        } else if (step == JpakeStep.CONFIRM_3_RECEIVED) {
170            this.clientNonce4 = generateNonce();
171            byte[] hashDigest3 = HmacSha256.hmacSha256(clientNonce4, Hkdf.build(serverNonce3, derivedSecret));
172
173            L.t(TAG, "Req4: clientNonce4=" + Hex.encodeHexString(clientNonce4));
174            L.t(TAG, "Req4: derivedSecret=" + Hex.encodeHexString(derivedSecret));
175            L.t(TAG, "Req4: serverNonce3=" + Hex.encodeHexString(serverNonce3));
176            L.t(TAG, "Req4: hashDigest3=" + Hex.encodeHexString(hashDigest3));
177            request = new Jpake4KeyConfirmationRequest(0,
178                    clientNonce4,
179                    Jpake4KeyConfirmationRequest.RESERVED,
180                    hashDigest3
181            );
182
183            step = JpakeStep.CONFIRM_4_SENT;
184        } else if (step == JpakeStep.CONFIRM_4_RECEIVED) {
185            byte[] hashDigest4 = HmacSha256.hmacSha256(serverNonce4, Hkdf.build(serverNonce3, derivedSecret));
186            // MessageDigest.isEqual is the constant-time comparison; the hex round trip it
187            // replaces short-circuited on the first differing nibble.
188            if (MessageDigest.isEqual(this.serverHashDigest4, hashDigest4)) {
189                L.i(TAG, "JpakeAuthBuilder HMAC SECRET VALIDATES");
190                step = JpakeStep.COMPLETE;
191            } else {
192                L.w(TAG, "JpakeAuthBuilder HMAC SECRET DOES NOT VALIDATE hashDigest=" + Hex.encodeHexString(hashDigest4));
193                L.w(TAG, "serverNonce4=" + Hex.encodeHexString(this.serverNonce4));
194                L.w(TAG, "derivedSecret=" + Hex.encodeHexString(this.derivedSecret));
195                L.w(TAG, "serverHashDigest4=" + Hex.encodeHexString(this.serverHashDigest4));
196                step = JpakeStep.INVALID;
197            }
198
199            return null;
200        } else {
201            return null;
202        }
203
204        this.sentMessages.add(request);
205        return request;
206    }
207
208    public void processResponse(Message response) {
209        this.receivedMessages.add(response);
210        if (response instanceof Jpake1aResponse) {
211            Jpake1aResponse m = (Jpake1aResponse) response;
212            L.t(TAG, "Res1a: " + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getCentralChallengeHash()));
213            this.serverRound1 = m.getCentralChallengeHash();
214
215            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_1A_RECEIVED;
216        } else if (response instanceof Jpake1bResponse) {
217            Jpake1bResponse m = (Jpake1bResponse) response;
218            L.t(TAG, "Res1b: " + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getCentralChallengeHash()));
219            byte[] fullServerRound1 = Bytes.combine(this.serverRound1, m.getCentralChallengeHash());
220            L.d(TAG, "FULL_ROUND_1_RESPONSE: " + Hex.encodeHexString(fullServerRound1));
221            this.serverRound1 = fullServerRound1;
222
223            this.cli.readRound1(fullServerRound1);
224            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_1B_RECEIVED;
225        } else if (response instanceof Jpake2Response) {
226            Jpake2Response m = (Jpake2Response) response;
227            L.t(TAG, "Res2: " + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getCentralChallengeHash()));
228            this.serverRound2 = m.getCentralChallengeHash();
229            L.d(TAG, "FULL_ROUND_2_RESPONSE: " + Hex.encodeHexString(this.serverRound2));
230
231            this.cli.readRound2(this.serverRound2);
232            step = JpakeStep.ROUND_2_RECEIVED;
233        } else if (response instanceof Jpake3SessionKeyResponse) {
234            Jpake3SessionKeyResponse m = (Jpake3SessionKeyResponse) response;
235            L.t(TAG, "Res3: nonce=" + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getDeviceKeyNonce()));
236            L.t(TAG, "Res3: reserved=" + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getDeviceKeyReserved()));
237
238            this.serverNonce3 = m.getDeviceKeyNonce();
239            step = JpakeStep.CONFIRM_3_RECEIVED;
240        } else if (response instanceof Jpake4KeyConfirmationResponse) {
241            Jpake4KeyConfirmationResponse m = (Jpake4KeyConfirmationResponse) response;
242            L.t(TAG, "JpakeAuthBuilder Res4: nonce=" + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getHashDigest()) + " hashDigest=" + Hex.encodeHexString(m.getNonce()));
243
244            this.serverNonce4 = m.getNonce();
245            this.serverHashDigest4 = m.getHashDigest();
246            step = JpakeStep.CONFIRM_4_RECEIVED;
247        }
248    }
249
250    byte[] generateNonce() {
251        byte[] nonce = new byte[8];
252        this.rand.nextBytes(nonce);
253        return nonce;
254    }
255
256    public enum JpakeStep {
257        BOOTSTRAP_INITIAL(0),
258        ROUND_1A_SENT(0),
259        ROUND_1A_RECEIVED(10),
260        ROUND_1B_SENT(20),
261        ROUND_1B_RECEIVED(30),
262        ROUND_2_SENT(40),
263        ROUND_2_RECEIVED(50),
264        CONFIRM_INITIAL(50),
265        CONFIRM_3_SENT(60),
266        CONFIRM_3_RECEIVED(70),
267        CONFIRM_4_SENT(80),
268        CONFIRM_4_RECEIVED(90),
269        COMPLETE(100),
270        INVALID(0)
271
272        ;
273
274        private int progressPercent;
275
276        JpakeStep(int progressPercent) {
277            this.progressPercent = progressPercent;
278        }
279
280        public int getProgressPercent() {
281            return progressPercent;
282        }
283    }
284
285    public boolean done() {
286        return step == JpakeStep.COMPLETE;
287    }
288
289    public boolean invalid() {
290        return step == JpakeStep.INVALID;
291    }
292
293    public JpakeStep getStep() {
294        return step;
295    }
296
297    public byte[] getDerivedSecret() {
298        return this.derivedSecret;
299    }
300
301    public byte[] getServerNonce() {
302        return this.serverNonce3;
303    }
304}
